reads.name: USD Coin
notChecked: transfer tax / honeypot: needs a live buy+sell simulation, not a static read
liquidity lock: needs the LP token holder list, which this reader does not fetch

flags: owner is a single EOA — one key controls this token
UPGRADEABLE PROXY — the implementation can be replaced by whoever controls the admin
masterMinter() exists — a separate key can grant mint rights
mint(address,uint256) IS present in the bytecode — supply can still be increased by whoever holds mint rights (not necessarily the owner; access control is a separate question)
paused() is present — transfers can be frozen by whoever controls it
